user.title: Create new list
user.description: Family Todo creates a real todo list that works with Home Assistant's own to-do card and voice assistant (Assist). Add more lists directly in the sidepanel.

corrupt_list.title: The list "{list_name}" could not be read
corrupt_list.description: Family Todo's storage file for the list "{list_name}" could not be read at startup ({error}) and has been reset to empty - any content it had is lost. A copy of the damaged file was saved in `.storage` (same folder, with a `.corrupt-` plus a timestamp added to the filename) in case you want to try recovering anything from it by hand.
